description: This file implements an AWS Transcribe Speech-to-Text service class using WebSocket streaming, supporting multiple languages, real-time transcription, and AWS credential management.

classes.name: AWSTranscribeSTTService
classes.description: A class providing real-time speech-to-text transcription via AWS Transcribe WebSocket API, supporting multiple languages and audio formats.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AWS Transcribe STT service with credentials, region, language, and sample rate settings.

methods.name: get_service_encoding
methods.description: Converts internal encoding format to AWS-compatible encoding format.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service and establishes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes audio bytes, sends them to AWS Transcribe, and yields error frames if issues occur.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from AWS Transcribe WebSocket, sending end-stream message.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Creates WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe with presigned URL.

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Maps internal language enum to AWS Transcribe language code.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from WebSocket, handling transcription results and errors.
